title: Active in-cycle adaptive feedback (POST-PILOT — feed/spindle/thermal closed loop)
brief: POST-PILOT continuation of MS22a. Now telemetry is captured (MS22a) and MS9 is trained on real data, this MS adds the actuation path: chatter onset → spindle-speed shift <200ms; thermal dT>15C → comp engaged. Required for marketing 'intelligent adaptive' claims post-ship. Gated on operator opt-in + MS9 Omega=1.0 status (no autonomous actuation without explicit safety green-light).

phases.title: Active feedback: feed override + spindle shift + thermal comp + safety interlock

units.title: AdaptiveControlEngine: chatter detection + feed override <200ms
exit_conditions: chatter onset (FFT spike at known stability lobe) triggers spindle-speed shift within 200ms
1 staged chatter scenario suppressed within 3 RPM steps
false-positive rate <5% on synthetic non-chatter noise (validated against MS22a labeled negatives)
tests: chatter + non-chatter signals + boundary cases
units.description: Reuses MS22a telemetry stream + chatter probability from SpindleHarmonicsQualityEngine. Pin process priority + IPC over socket to hold 200ms budget on Windows.

units.title: Thermal compensation: dT > 15C engages comp from MachineRegistry thermal-map
exit_conditions: spindle thermistor + ballscrew temp ingested via MS22a stream
dT > 15C engages thermal-map comp from MachineRegistry per machine
tests: simulated thermal ramp engages at correct threshold; rollback when dT <10C
units.description: Standard thermal-comp tables. Reuse MachineRegistry.thermal_map fields if present, else add via MS27 migration runner.

units.title: Safety interlock: actuation requires Omega=1.0 from MS9 + operator opt-in
exit_conditions: any speed/feed override blocked unless current job has Omega=1.0 per omega-tolerance.json
operator must opt-in per machine per shift via MS24 CLI prompt
kill-switch wired to E-stop sequence (hardware fallback)
tests: 3 actuation requests, 1 with Ω<1.0 (BLOCKED), 1 without operator opt-in (BLOCKED), 1 fully gated (PASSES)
units.description: No autonomous actuation without explicit safety green-light. Operator opt-in defaults OFF; explicit per-shift activation.

acceptance: in-cycle MTConnect feed-rate override demonstrated on 1 mill + 1 lathe + 1 WEDM; chatter onset triggers spindle shift <200ms; thermal-comp engages at dT>15C; actuation gated on MS9 Omega=1.0 (per omega-tolerance.json) AND operator opt-in (per MS24 CLI); kill-switch tested on E-stop.

risks.description: Real-time loop on Windows blows 200ms budget; mitigation = pin process priority + IPC over socket not file
Operators distrust auto-override (per pass-2 metric-reality gap); mitigation = explicit opt-in per machine per shift; defaults OFF; CLI surfaces every override decision for audit
OPC-UA security; covered by MS20 OT-IT-SECURITY which blocks this milestone
